name: pi-control
description: Local-first web control plane for the Pi coding agent

scripts.image:base: pnpm --filter @pi-control/workspace-agent bundle && podman build -t pi-control/base:local -f images/base/Dockerfile images/base
scripts.image:profiles: podman build -t pi-control/python:local -f images/profiles/python/Dockerfile images/profiles/python && podman build -t pi-control/universal:local -f images/profiles/universal/Dockerfile images/profiles/universal
